title: 只邀请需要的人深入讨论
premise: 今日承诺确定，安排取消测试与契约问题的短讨论。
listeningTask: 听清会后参与者、议题和结束条件。

lines.en: The follow-up slot starts after this standup. We have a twenty-minute hard stop there.
lines.zh: 站会后开始跟进讨论，二十分钟到点结束。

lines.en: Raj and I will pair on it. Cancellation scheduling is the first concrete topic.
lines.zh: Raj和我结对，第一个具体议题是取消调度。

lines.en: Okay, let's take it offline as agreed. We'll need the sanitized samples there itself.
lines.zh: 好，按约定会后单聊，当场就需要脱敏样本。

lines.en: I'll bring those and join the opening. Maybe ten minutes, then back to integration.
lines.zh: 我带样本参加开头，可能十分钟，之后回去集成。

lines.en: I don't need the full test discussion. Tag me if the interface design changes.
lines.zh: 我不必全程参加测试讨论，接口设计变化再通知我。

lines.en: Good, each new action item gets recorded. The end-of-day checkpoint stays at five.
lines.zh: 好，新增任务逐项记录，日终检查仍在五点。

lines.en: Our output is a deterministic failing test. Not a new architecture proposal this morning.
lines.zh: 产出是确定性失败测试，不是今天上午提新架构。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll bring the current minimal harness. We can demonstrate cancellation without live API access.
lines.zh: 同意，我带最小测试框架，不访问真实接口也能展示取消。

lines.en: I'll start review at eleven as promised. Keep the standup notes linked to tasks.
lines.zh: 按承诺十一点评审，站会记录关联任务。

lines.en: Then I'll send the contract questions now. Everyone has today's next step and owner.
lines.zh: 那我现在发契约问题，大家都明确今天下一步和负责人。

scene: 今日承诺确定，安排取消测试与契约问题的短讨论。
